messages:
anya: Quick idea 1: add an "Estimated units" pill on Route pages for Embeds so users see if a request will overflow before they send it. Right now folks only learn about 413s after the fact.

phil: We already produce estimates in the opt-in preflight header (`X-Embed-Preflight`). We could expose a summarized version: `est_units`, `est_confidence`, and a short `split_summary`. Example preflight body (internal):

```
{\n  "est_units": 14,\n  "est_confidence": "medium",\n  "split_summary": "3 chunks (2x768,1x512)"\n}
```

maria: UX: show as "~14 units 7% (may split into 3 chunks)" with a small help tooltip and a one-click SDK snippet showing how to set a smaller batch or the per-item dim hint. Keep it minimal, no raw JSON in UI.

jamie: Runtime note: estimator currently scans full payload to be exact which hurts latency for huge requests. Proposal: cheap fast-path for the Console estimate: sample N items (N=3) and if variance high, return low confidence and queue a background scan to update metrics. That avoids blocking UI.

phil: +1. Add `est_confidence` values: low, medium, high. For mixed dims the heuristic will detect from samples; if low-confidence, Console shows suggestion "Consider using client-side chunking or provide `dims` header".

anya: Privacy: make preflight optional per-tenant. Console toggle "Enable preflight estimates" with audit log. Default on for self-serve orgs, off for enterprise until they opt in.

maria: Telemetry: emit `embed.preflight.estimated_units` (gauge) and `embed.preflight.error_rate` for estimator mismatches. Tag by `route`, `env`, and `confidence`. Avoid high-cardinality tags like full tenant id; use tenant bucket (hash mod 100) if needed.

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: test vectors uploaded to staging bucket `/staging/embed-testvectors/v2` for canary runs.

jamie: Rollout plan: dark launch the estimate to 5% of traffic, collect predicted vs actual units p50/p90 error rates. Gate: auto-rollback if median error > 20% for 1h or 413 regressions increase. I'll own the rollback playbook.

phil: Observability: send `split_summary` to internal logs only, keep UI-friendly `split_summary_label` for Console. Build a dashboard overlay: predicted vs actual units + oversize 413 rate. Add an alert: if per-route 413 rate > 0.5% and predicted_units drop > 30% simultaneously -> page eng-platform on-call.

anya: I'll mock the pill and the small help modal. Plan: pill shows estimated units, confidence color (green/yellow/red), and a button "Show fix" which opens example SDK calls with chunking. Will drop mock by EOD.

maria: Also add a Console toggle to hide per-route preds for customers who disable preflight. When disabled, show hint: "Preflight disabled by tenant settings".

phil: Implementation notes: keep estimator compute cheap (sample-first), expose preflight API at internal endpoint `/v1/embed/preflight` and rate-limit it. For public API we only accept a flagged header from Console service account to avoid abuse.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight-estimator v1 pushed to staging (canary 5%) at 2026-03-20T17:22:00Z.

jamie: I'll schedule canary metrics job: compare predicted vs actual units for last 4 hours every 15m. Also check split stability (how often requests are re-split differently).

anya: Thanks team. Owners: @jamie rollback + canary, @phil telemetry + rate limits, @maria UI copy + alerts, Ill do Console mock. Sync tomorrow 10am to review canary metrics.

phil: Sounds good. Small follow-up: for mixed-dim clients we should add a short snippet to SDKs that computes dims client-side and sends `X-Embed-Dims` hint to preflight so estimator can be exact without scanning.

maria: add that to the help modal too.

ingest-bot: note: stress test harness available at `https://internal.redwood/tools/embed-stress` for validating estimator under large payloads.

anya: Perfect. Closing thread, will post mock and a short RFC link later.
